body:
Step 1 of docs/ios-port-design.md. The iOS implementations of :core's platform interfaces, in
:core's iosMain (or :shared's), compiled on Linux by klib cross-compilation, not yet run:
Keychain-backed SecretStore and LastOpenedListStore, the database file location and Room builder,
a device id stored like Android's, the Darwin Ktor engine with the self-signed-certificate opt-in
(debug-only, as on Android), and a SyncTrigger that syncs while the app is open (background
refresh is step 4). Document in android/core/README.md which Swift side, if any, each needs.
title: iPhone port step 1: iOS implementations of the platform interfaces
